responsibility: Implementation of the small garbage-collected hash map used by the Objective-C front end to map identifier trees to other trees, such as class or method metadata entries. It provides allocation, load-factor tuning, and resizing/rehashing for the open-addressed table that objc-act.cc and related code use for semantic lookup caches, complementing the inline lookup/insertion API in objc-map.h.
same_name_distinction: Out-of-line implementation for the lightweight ObjC identifier-to-tree map, providing allocation, load-factor control, growth, and rehashing of the backing table. Unlike objc-map.h, it supplies the storage-management and resize logic rather than the inline lookup/insertion API and data layout.
